title: fix: resolve context tokens in every directly authored data node's own filter (objectui#10666)
body:
Fixes #10666
Clause-②: yes — `@object-ui/react` gains one hook export, `useResolvedFilter`. It is additive, and existing callers are unchanged.

This is the sweep half of the family closure card, under seat answer B (comment 5838380906) and the re-scoped claim 5838679906. PR objectui#10705 fixed `object-gallery` (part 1). This PR fixes the eleven remaining census nodes and closes the card.

## What changed

**One shared hold, exported from `@object-ui/react`.** `useResolvedFilter(filter, scope)` sits beside `useFilterScope`. It is `plugin-list`'s `useResolvedAuthoredFilter` together with its comparator `isSameAuthoredFilter`, moved into `packages/react/src/hooks/useResolvedFilter.ts` (git records a rename). The plugin-list module is deleted, and `ListView` and `ObjectGallery` import the shared hook. The hold, its key (the authored filter compared by structure, plus the scope's three members read one by one) and the comparator are unchanged. `@object-ui/react` already depended on `@object-ui/core`, so it can import `resolveFilterPlaceholders` directly.

- **One addition to the hold (a fork, see below).** A filter that the resolver leaves unchanged (it has no token, or only tokens the scope cannot resolve) is handed out as the authored value itself. The resolver's structurally equal copy is not used. So a token-free filter reaches `$filter` by identity, as it did before.
- **Docs.** The hook has JSDoc, and `packages/react/README.md` has a new "useFilterScope / useResolvedFilter" section. `check:readme-exports --list` judges both names `real`.

**The eleven nodes.** Each node now reads its own filter through the hold. The query and the fetch effect's key read the held value, never the raw filter.

| node | file | what now reads the held value |
|---|---|---|
| `object-calendar` | `plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx` | the object `find`, the inline `ValueDataSource` `find`, and the effect deps |
| `object-gantt` | `plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` | `reload`'s `find`, and both dependency lists |
| `object-kanban` | `plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx` | the `find`, and the effect deps |
| `object-map` | `plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx` | the object and inline `find`s, the committed-query key, and the effect deps |
| `object-timeline` | `plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx` | the `find`; `filterKey` (already a content key) is now taken over the held value |
| `object-tree` | `plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx` | the object and inline `find`s, and the effect deps |
| `record:related_list` | `plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` | `toFilterNodeSafely` and `filterKey`, before the merge with the parent scope |
| `record:line_items` | `plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx` | `toFilterNodeSafely` and `filterKey`, before the merge with the parent scope (no save-in-flight hunk is touched) |
| `element:repeater` | `components/src/renderers/basic/data-list.tsx` | `query.$filter` and `filterKey` |
| `element:number` | `components/src/renderers/basic/elements.tsx` | the `aggregate` filter, the `find` fallback's `$filter`, and `filterKey` |
| `element:record_picker` | `components/src/renderers/basic/record-picker.tsx` | the winning `composed?.filter ?? props.filter`, then `$filter` and `filterKey` |

**`@object-ui/types`, prose only.** The `filter` docblocks on `ObjectMapSchema`, `ObjectTreeSchema`, `ObjectGanttSchema`, `ObjectCalendarSchema`, `ObjectKanbanSchema`, `ObjectChartSchema` and `ObjectGallerySchema` used to say "forwarded verbatim as `$filter`". They now say the context tokens are resolved first. The five matching zod `.describe()` strings and one import comment were changed the same way. No type changed.

**Changeset:** `.changeset/10666-filter-token-sweep.md`: `@object-ui/react` minor, `@object-ui/types` patch, and each node package patch (`plugin-calendar`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-map`, `plugin-timeline`, `plugin-tree`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-list`, `components`). None is major.

## The pin table: red, then green

`apps/console/src/__tests__/filterContextTokensSweep-10666.test.tsx` is one `describe.each` table with 18 rows and 4 cells per row. It lives in `apps/console` because that is the one package that declares all nine node packages (the objectui#4409 dependency-direction method).

Each row renders the directly authored node through the real `SchemaRenderer` and its package registration, under `FilterScopeProvider` (`usr_42`, `org_7`), over a data source that records every query. For the inline paths, a spy on `ValueDataSource.prototype.find` records the queries instead.

The four cells are:
- USER: `{current_user_id}` goes out resolved, and the whole query equals the query the literal id sends.
- ORG: `{current_org_id}` goes out resolved.
- CONTROL: a token-free filter goes out unchanged (for a pass-through node, it deep-equals the authored filter).
- REBUILD: three re-renders that each rebuild an equal token filter add no query.

The pins-only commit `5ae7e1159d` ran against the unfixed code: 38 failed, 34 passed (exit 1). The fix is `69d68598df`.

| row | red at `5ae7e1159d` | green at head |
|---|---|---|
| object-calendar (object) | USER, ORG, REBUILD | 4/4 |
| object-calendar (inline) | USER, ORG, REBUILD | 4/4 |
| object-gantt | USER, ORG, REBUILD | 4/4 |
| object-kanban | USER, ORG, REBUILD | 4/4 |
| object-map (object) | USER, ORG, REBUILD | 4/4 |
| object-map (inline) | USER, ORG, REBUILD | 4/4 |
| object-timeline | USER, ORG | 4/4 |
| object-tree (object) | USER, ORG, REBUILD | 4/4 |
| object-tree (inline) | USER, ORG, REBUILD | 4/4 |
| record:related_list | USER, ORG | 4/4 |
| record:line_items | USER, ORG | 4/4 |
| element:repeater | USER, ORG | 4/4 |
| element:number (aggregate) | USER, ORG | 4/4 |
| element:number (find fallback) | USER, ORG | 4/4 |
| element:record_picker | USER, ORG | 4/4 |
| object-gallery (regression) | none | 4/4 |
| object-grid (regression) | none | 4/4 |
| list-view (regression) | none | 4/4 |

- The token cells failed on the literal. An example failure: "object-kanban sent the literal token: expected '[["owner","=","{current_user_id}"]]' not to contain '{current_user_id}'".
- The REBUILD cells failed only on the nodes whose fetch effect keyed on the filter's identity. An example: "object-calendar (object) re-queried on a re-render that changed nothing: expected 4 to be 1".
- The nodes that were already keyed by content passed REBUILD on base, as expected. Those are timeline, related_list, line_items and the three elements.
- CONTROL was green on every row on base, so token-free behaviour is pinned as unchanged.

At head `507214a742` (after merging `origin/main`), the table passed 72/72 in one run with the hook test, both objectui#10607 pins, the gallery pin, all four objectui#10657 masked-column pins, the objectui#8176, #7711 and #9136 member pins, and the machine-locale census: 13 files, 172 tests passed, exit 0.

**Hook unit test.** `packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/useResolvedFilter.test.tsx` has 10 cells:
- it resolves the user and org tokens;
- the same reference comes back across same-input re-renders, and across equal rebuilds;
- `{now}` is held;
- it re-resolves on a change of structure, and on a change of a scope member;
- a token-free filter comes back as the authored value, and a resolved one comes back as a new value;
- an absent filter passes through;
- an unresolvable token stays in place and draws the shared warning.

## Ablation on the shared hook

`ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `return held.resolved as T;` with the bare per-render `return resolveFilterPlaceholders(authored, scope) as T;`.
- The anchor went from 1 hit to 0, and the blob went from `372374462041` to `8468e2e161e7`.
- The run covered the pin table and the hook test: 45 failed and 37 passed (exit 1).
- On every identity-keyed node row (calendar, gantt, kanban, map and tree, each on both paths) and on the gallery and list-view regression rows, every cell went red, REBUILD included. The copy minted on every render re-queried without end, which gave "issued no query" readings and 15000ms timeouts.
- `object-timeline` USER went red once.
- The content-keyed rows stayed green: related_list, line_items and the three elements. There the JSON content key, not the hold, is what keeps the fetch steady.
- In the hook test, the four stability cells went red (for example "expected [ [ 'owner', '=', 'usr_42' ] ] to be [ [ 'owner', '=', 'usr_42' ] ]").
- Restore: the blob after restore was `372374462041`, equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- `@object-ui/*` resolves to `src/` through the root vitest alias, so this ablation has no `dist/` leg.

## The fork (flagged for the seat)

The existing member pins read `$filter` BY IDENTITY: objectui#8176 on `object-kanban` (3 cells), objectui#7711 on `object-calendar` (3 cells) and objectui#9136 on `object-tree` (1 cell). `resolveFilterPlaceholders` copies arrays, so with the hold moved exactly as it was, those 7 cells went red on a token-free filter.

- **Taken, option B:** the hold hands out the authored value whenever the resolver changed nothing (one structural comparison per resolution, which runs only when the inputs change). A token-free filter now reaches the query exactly as before, by identity, and no existing pin was edited.
- **Not taken, option A:** move the hold byte for byte and relax those 7 cells to `toEqual`. That would weaken pins whose authors chose `toBe` on purpose.

The one existing test that was edited is the objectui#8174 SOURCE pin in `packages/types`. It looked for the literal text `$filter: schema.filter` in the kanban and calendar sources, and it now reads both halves of the new chain: `useResolvedFilter(schema.filter, filterScope)` and `$filter: queryFilter`.

## Verification at head `507214a742`

Heavy runs went through the shared verify lock.

- **Build.** `turbo run build` over the dependency closure of the 12 touched packages: 14 tasks successful.
- **Type-check.** `pnpm --filter` over the 12 touched packages, `run type-check`: 12 Done, exit 0. `react`'s `tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new hook test once.
- **Full package suites**, all exit 0:
  - After the final merge: `plugin-detail` (214 files passed and 1 skipped; 2102 tests passed and 8 skipped); `plugin-form` plus `types` (368 files; 6747 tests passed and 1 skipped); and `components` in two halves (renderers, notifications and ui: 135 files, 1289 tests passed and 10 skipped; `__tests__`: 177 files passed and 1 skipped, 1767 tests passed and 7 skipped).
  - After the first merge: `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-gantt` and `plugin-timeline`, in one run with `types` and the pins.
  - Before either merge: `react`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-map`, `plugin-tree` and `plugin-list`. Neither merge changed a source file in these packages.
- **Gates**, each exit 0: `check:changeset-claims` (report-only), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check-changeset-presence` (20 source files of 13 released packages, 1 changeset), `changeset:check` (no major), `check-changeset-overwrite` (1 added, 0 modified), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `check:side-effects-array`, and `check-governed-queue-guard --test` (NOT GOVERNED, 22 paths).
- **README exports.** `check:readme-exports --list` judges `useFilterScope` and `useResolvedFilter` in `packages/react/README.md` `real`. The whole-tree run exits non-zero only because 22 packages were not built in this worktree (0 fabricated after the rebuild), so the whole-tree verdict is NOT MEASURED.
- **eslint**, plain form, on the 20 changed TS files: 0 errors. Warnings, merge-base against head: unchanged in every modified file except `record-picker.tsx`, which went from 11 to 10. The new files have 0, except the pin table, which has 1.
- **NOT MEASURED:** `check:eager-closure` and `check:sdui-registration-pins` (both need a console production build); repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full test farm, which belong to CI.

## Merges

Two merges of `origin/main`:
- `bd254f7637`: one import-line conflict in `RelatedList.tsx`, resolved as a union. It keeps objectui#10690's `useSettledSchema` and adds `useFilterScope` and `useResolvedFilter`.
- `507214a742`: brings in objectui#10657 (masked columns). It merged with no conflict, and both behaviours hold: `RelatedList`'s `masked` column stamping, and its held resolved scope filter. Draft PR objectui#10650's save-in-flight hunks in `LineItemsPanel.tsx` are not touched. This PR changes only the `filter` read there.

## Acceptance notes

- **Fewer queries, by design.** On the five identity-keyed nodes, a host that rebuilds an equal filter inline no longer re-queries. A structurally different filter, or a new user or organization, still re-queries.
- **Date macros** in these nodes' own filters now resolve on the client, in the browser's local time, as they already do for `list-view`, `object-grid` and `object-view`. Before, the server resolved them in the tenant's time zone.
- **The second copy.** `plugin-grid`'s `ObjectGrid.tsx` still holds its own copy of the hold and the comparator (`useResolvedGridFilters`, from PR objectui#10656). The claim did not cover that file. It could become `useResolvedFilter({ filter, defaultFilters }, scope)`, with the same behaviour.
- **Stale prose outside this surface.** Some sentences now describe the old read: pending changesets from objectui#8174 and #8186 describe the renderers as "lowering `schema.filter` onto `$filter`"; the objectui#8176 pin's header says "nothing between the schema and that call reads a member key"; and `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` still carries "forwarded verbatim as `$filter`" in its `ObjectKanbanSchema` table. None of these was edited here.
- **Against ObjectStack**, the server also expands `{current_user_id}` for a signed-in request, so there this is defence in depth.

The session behind this change is `https://claude.ai/code/session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb` (domain:ui seat 3, dispatched dev).
